content: {"paper_id":"W4365807485","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"nonnegative-matrix-factorization","exact_quote":"Nonnegative matrix factorization(NMF) algorithms are a series of dimensional reduction techniques widely used in data preprocessing.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文提出LpCNMF，即以标签传播为基础的约束非负矩阵分解，属于NMF方法。"},{"keyword_id":"dimensionality-reduction","exact_quote":"NMF algorithms are a series of dimensional reduction techniques widely used in data preprocessing.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确将NMF表述为降维技术，并关注低维表示，满足降维任务定义。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"makes use of a small amount of labeled data to predict the label information of the unlabeled data","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"结合少量标注数据与未标注数据，通过标签传播预测未标注标签，属半监督学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"adopts graph and label propagation as regularization terms","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"将图作为正则项，用样本图结构约束低维表示，满足图正则化定义。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"the LpCNMF algorithm increases the update of the predictive membership matrix obtained by label propagation","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"标签传播对未标注样本产生预测隶属矩阵，并在LpCNMF中迭代更新，作为后续训练信号。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"makes use of a small amount of labeled data to predict the label information of the unlabeled data","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"仅使用少量标注数据并利用未标注数据，监督信息不完整，且该不完整监督是核心研究条件。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
